artworks.title: Ah! Monsieur Gobinet, dans quel temps ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men conversing on a street. They are standing facing each other. One man extends his right arm towards the other, who is holding a cane. The man on the left has a narrow face with prominent eyes, wearing a long coat and a top hat. The man on the right has a round face with a large nose, dressed similarly and holding a cane. The background depicts an urban scene with buildings and street details. The illustration has a drawn, monochrome aesthetic.

artworks.title: Un jour ou l'on paye cinq francs
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures examining a display of large pumpkins on a table. The color scheme is black and white, with grey tones adding texture. The figures are on the left side, dressed in 19th-century clothing, with two wearing tall top hats. The pumpkins are on the right side, partly hidden by the figures.

artworks.title: M. Prudhomme visitant les ateliers ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a gallery. One man is on the left, viewing a painting, wearing a dark jacket, white waistcoat, and striped trousers. The other man, on the right, is standing upright holding a cigar, wearing a lighter-colored suit with a waistcoat and tie. The room contains several framed paintings on the walls, with one in front of the first man. The background shows a wood-paneled floor and walls with more framed artwork.

artworks.title: M. Vautour: Je ne saurais trop ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of two men interacting in an indoor setting. The tall man is holding a long object and the shorter man is holding a hat. The tall man appears dressed in formal attire with a top hat. They are standing in front of a wall with the word "CONCIERGE" on it. French text at the bottom adds further context. The style of the drawing is exaggerated and may be seen as satirical or humorous.

artworks.title: Descendant joyeusement le fleuve de la vie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four men in a small boat. Three men are reclined or lying down, while the fourth man is standing and drinking directly from a large bottle. The men are dressed in long-sleeved shirts and loose-fitting pants. The boat is on water with gentle waves, and in the background, there is a faint outline of some trees and a building.

artworks.title: Villégiature
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor bathing scene. The drawing shows a man in a large wooden bathtub outdoors, surrounded by trees and foliage. A woman is standing beside the tub wearing a large hat and glasses, holding towels or clothes. The style is humorous and slightly exaggerated, providing a satirical take on outdoor leisure. The text at the bottom adds a comedic context to the scene.

artworks.title: Un abri a la campagne
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man seated in a chair outdoors beneath a tree. The man appears relaxed with his shoes propped on the ground and looking upwards. A dog sits beside him, facing away. The background shows a rural setting with a fence and vegetation. Vines and shrubs are visible behind the figure, creating a lush environment. The style of the drawing is loose and expressive.

artworks.title: Aux bains Deligny
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a swimming scene with multiple figures in a pool. The artwork depicts individuals at a public swimming pool, some ascending and descending a wooden ladder, while others are in the water. The netting and railings suggest a structured swimming environment. The figures are detailed and expressive, showing movement and interaction. The style of drawing is similar to that of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Dites donc, monsieur Beaufumé ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring several figures in a public bath or steam room. The monochrome style artwork shows people seated on benches, with a group of figures standing in the background. Three main figures are depicted in the foreground: one draped in a towel, another smoking and seated with casual posture, and a third facing away. The setting is bustling with activity, emphasizing a relaxed atmosphere. The artwork uses detailed line work and shading to depict the figures and the environment.

artworks.title: Allons Bon! J'avais oublié de décharger mon fusil!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a comedic scene involving a sudden indoor gun discharge. Several individuals exhibit shocked expressions following an unexpected gunshot. The central figure appears to have inadvertently fired a rifle, as evidenced by the large burst of smoke emanating from the barrel. Surrounding figures react to the sudden noise and smoke with dramatic gestures and wide-eyed expressions. The setting appears to be indoors, with details of the room sketched in the background. The style is reminiscent of caricatures with exaggerated features.

artworks.title: Oh! Le gueux ... il a été mourir la ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image shows two men and a dead hare. The man on the left is next to a railing, wearing a coat, collared shirt, and holding a long stick. The man on the right is standing on a railway platform, pointing towards the hare on the train tracks. The dead hare is lying on its side. A steam train is approaching on the tracks, with open fields in the background.

artworks.title: Combien votre lièvre, l'ami?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction involving a hunter and a villager in a rural setting. Two figures stand facing each other. One holds a rifle, wearing a hat and glasses, and carries a bag. The other figure holds a hare by its legs, wearing a cap and loose clothing. Between them, a dog looks up eagerly at the hare. The landscape around them is simple, with horizontal lines indicating the ground. The drawing is labelled "EMOTIONS DE CHASSE" at the top. The style and detail suggest a focus on human interaction, particularly around hunting.

artworks.title: Une reine se préparant a une grande tirade
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image shows a theatrical scene with an audience. It depicts a performance on stage, with a figure standing in the center. Another figure is on the left, partially obscured by a curtain-like element. The audience is detailed with abstract faces, conveying a lively atmosphere. The title at the bottom is "Une reine se préparant à une grande tirade."

artworks.title: La danseur qui se pique d'avoir conservé ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ballet performance. The drawing shows a stage with ballet dancers in various poses. The central dancer is leaping with arms outstretched. Additional dancers are visible in the background, indicating a full ensemble performance. In the foreground, an orchestra is depicted with a conductor facing away, directing the musicians. The drawing is in a monochromatic style, using lines and shading to depict motion, depth, and the lively atmosphere of a theatrical performance.

artworks.title: Un engagement d'artiste
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in conversation. One figure is a man with a prominent nose, wearing a suit with hands in pockets, leaning slightly forward. The other figure is wearing a bonnet and a striped dress, looking up at the man. The backdrop features printed text. The drawing depicts a social or professional exchange. The text below is framed with the title "UN ENGAGEMENT D'ARTISTE" and implies a humorous theatrical agreement.

artworks.title: Un cours de morale moderne
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a conversation. One figure is seated, gesturing with one hand, and the other figure stands calmly with hands clasped. The seated figure appears somewhat corpulent, dressed in voluminous clothing, with a prominent collar, while the standing figure is slender, with a more form-fitting outfit. Both figures have exaggerated features, particularly in their facial expressions, which conveys a sense of interaction or dialogue. The setting is indoors, suggested by the presence of a floor and chair, with an understated background to focus attention on the figures.

artworks.title: Comme vous arrivez tard a la bourse ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men in conversation at a social gathering. It features two figures standing face to face, both wearing formal coats. The figure on the left is slightly hunched and holds what appears to be a top hat, while the figure on the right has his hands in his pockets, with his chest out and head held high. In the background, there are blurred outlines of a crowd engaged in conversation. The style of this drawing resembles a cartoon or caricature. The drawing captures a moment of interaction between the two men.

artworks.title: Nouveaux équipements pour la chasse au lion
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures enclosed in protective gear. One figure is covered in spikes and holds a rifle, while the other is enclosed in a cage. The text at the bottom of the image references new equipment for hunting lions, suggesting the outfits are designed for protection in such a context.

artworks.title: Rèapparition des tritons ... de l'océan
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people partially submerged in water up to their chests. The person on the left has a round face with a strong jawline and short, curly hair, while the person on the right has a long face and a prominent nose, wearing a cap. Both individuals are dressed in dark, loose-fitting garments. The background features several figures on the shoreline, with some standing and others sitting or reclining, and what appears to be a structure or an incline in the distance. The setting looks like a beach scene, and the water ripples gently around the two central figures.

artworks.title: Le restaurant de l'exposition
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image shows two figures in a room resembling a restaurant. The setting includes one seated figure and one standing figure, both dressed formally with aprons. The room contains a long table and a curtain, behind which there is a crowd of people. The drawing style is loose and sketch-like, with exaggerated features on the central figures. The bottom of the image includes French text referring to "LE RESTAURANT DE L'EXPOSITION."

artworks.title: Triste contenance de la sculpture ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure in a seated position with its head tilted back, mouth open, arms raised, and fists clenched. It is created in black and white, resembling a stone-like material. The sculpture is placed on a pedestal in a room with people wearing late 19th-century attire. The viewers are looking in different directions, with some observing the sculpture and others focusing elsewhere. The background features framed artwork on the walls, suggesting an art gallery or exhibition setting.

artworks.title: Un effet de crinoline au bord de la mer
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman. The man is on the left, standing with his hands at his sides and wearing a checkered outfit. He has an expressive expression on his face. The woman is on the right, shown in profile with her dress billowing. Her hair is covered with a headscarf. The background features a coastal scene with the sea, ships, and a sky with light clouds.

artworks.title: Ayant ... trouvé le moyen de passe agréablement l'été
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting in a body of water. The person on the left is sitting upright, while the person on the right leans back with their hands clasped resting on their stomach. Both figures are looking upwards with relaxed facial expressions, and their hair appears short and somewhat unkempt. The left person is wearing a draped garment, while the right person has a striped shirt, and their clothing is partially submerged in the water. Next to the person on the right, in the water, is a bottle. The background consists of trees with thick trunks and branches extending outward, creating a shaded area above the two figures.

artworks.title: Faut que je egardions comment qu'murit l'raisin ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in a vineyard setting. The man on the left stands upright with hands behind his back, wearing a cap, vest, shirt, and pants. The man on the right is bent forward with hands on his knees, wearing a pointed hat, vest, and pants. They are surrounded by rows of grapevines in a cartoonish style.
